abiJson.author: Hossein Boustani
abiJson.description: LMSR Market Maker for TON Prediction Market - automated pricing and trade execution

declarations.name: MarketConfig
declarations.description: Market configuration stored in a separate cell reference

declarations.name: MarketState
declarations.description: Market state data stored in a separate cell reference

get_methods.name: calcMarginalPrice
get_methods.description:
Compute the marginal price for a given outcome index.
price_i = exp(q_i / b) / sum(exp(q_j / b)) for all j
Uses the offset technique in log2 space (same as lmsrCost) to prevent overflow.
Returns price in Q64.64 format.

get_methods.name: getNetCost
get_methods.description:
Compute the net cost of a trade without executing it.
Takes a trade amounts cell (array of int64 values) and returns net cost in raw token units.
